items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: But I played with Kid Rene.

ctx.x: When Louis, when Joe Oliver sent for Louis, for Louis. I played that dance out there at the fire ground. Oh yeah. But I played with Kid Rene.
Good luck, alright. How was he on the top? Oh, the greatest. I heard him in the late years when he, you know, he started sick and wasn't... He was going down, yeah.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: He was good. Good, good, good. Old Man Kimmel, too.

ctx.x: He was good. Good, good, good. Old Man Kimmel, too. Oh, yeah.
That's right. He played on the boat, too, didn't he?
